title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Blackcurrant Passion Ice Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Blackcurrant Passion Ice by Doozy Infinity offers a striking combination of rich, dark fruit and exotic sweetness. Jammy Blackcurrant brings a deep, almost syrupy base, while Passionfruit cuts through with its tart, tropical character. The addition of Ice rounds out the flavour, delivering a cool, breezy finish that keeps the fruit blend tasting well-defined from first puff to last. Blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio, this high-VG e-liquid is ideal for Sub-Ohm vaping in advanced kits and powerful DTL (direct-to-lung) devices. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with space to add two 10ml nic shots for a customisable strength. Part of the Doozy Infinity range, this e-liquid delivers bold, satisfying flavour and smooth vapour production for vapers who prefer a richer, cloud-filled vape.
